title: Influence outside the dependence set
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and suppose $f$ depends only on coordinates in a set $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. For any real parameter $\rho$ and any coordinate $i\notin J$, the stable influence of $f$ at $i$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of coordinates
